# Made with Claude

> > A curated gallery showcasing interactive artifacts created with Claude AI, featuring games, tools, visualizations, and demos built using React, HTML, SVG, and other web technologies.

Made with Claude is a community-driven platform where users can discover, share, and remix Claude Artifacts—interactive applications and visualizations generated by Anthropic's Claude AI assistant. The site demonstrates Claude's capabilities in creating everything from productivity tools to data visualizations and entertainment.
